description.zh: 数字从 0（或旧值）滚动增长到目标值，让计数过程本身表达"数据在增长"。 常用于数据看板大数字、统计区与里程碑（"10 万用户"）。 数字成为动效的主角，比静态数值更有说服力。
description.en: Animates a number from zero (or a previous value) up to its target, so the counting itself tells the story of growth. Common on dashboard KPIs, stats sections and milestones ("100k users") — the digit becomes the animation, far more persuasive than a static figure.

use_when.zh: 首屏或统计区的大数字（KPI、用户数、下载量）
use_when.en: Big numbers on heroes and stats — KPIs, users, downloads

use_when.zh: 数字进入视口时触发一次，强调里程碑
use_when.en: One-shot count-up when the figure scrolls into view

use_when.zh: 数值更新时从旧值过渡到新值，保持连续感
use_when.en: Transitioning from an old value to a new one

avoid_when.zh: 高频刷新的实时数值（一直在滚，读不了）
avoid_when.en: Rapidly updating live values — perpetual rolling is unreadable

avoid_when.zh: 需要精确抄录的数字（金额、账号、验证码）
avoid_when.en: Figures users must transcribe exactly — amounts, IDs

avoid_when.zh: 表格内的密集小数字（噪音大于价值）
avoid_when.en: Dense small numbers inside tables — noise over value

note.zh: 起步快后段减速，最自然的落定
note.en: Fast start, eased landing — the natural default

note.zh: 千分位、单位、小数同步插值
note.en: Thousands separators, units and decimals interpolate in sync

notes.zh: CSS 无法直接给文本计数，实用做法是 requestAnimationFrame 插值 + ease-out 曲线， 时长 1～2s。必须加 font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums 防止数字宽度抖动； 千分位与单位在每帧一起格式化。尊重 prefers-reduced-motion——直接显示终值。
notes.en: CSS cannot count text; the practical recipe is requestAnimationFrame interpolation with an ease-out curve over 1–2s. Always add font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums to stop width jitter, and format separators/units every frame. Respect prefers-reduced-motion by showing the final value directly.

basic.zh: 给统计区的大数字添加从 0 滚动到目标值的计数动画。
basic.en: Add a count-up animation to the stats — numbers roll from 0 to their target.

design.zh: 统计数字进入视口后 1.6s 内从 0 计数到目标值，ease-out 减速落定，等宽数字防抖动，千分位同步格式化；仅触发一次。
design.en: When stats enter the viewport, count from 0 to target over 1.6s with an ease-out landing, tabular digits to prevent jitter, thousands separators formatted per frame; trigger once only.

implementation.zh: 用 requestAnimationFrame 插值，progress 经 easeOutCubic(t) 变换，值为 Math.round(target * p)，toLocaleString 格式化。容器加 tabular-nums。IntersectionObserver 触发一次；prefers-reduced-motion 直接渲染终值。
implementation.en: Interpolate with requestAnimationFrame, ease via easeOutCubic(t), value = Math.round(target * p), formatted with toLocaleString. Apply tabular-nums to the container. Trigger once via IntersectionObserver; render the final value under prefers-reduced-motion.

agent.zh:
为项目统计区的大数字添加计数动画。

先检查现有数字展示组件，避免与实时刷新逻辑冲突。
要求：
- rAF + ease-out 插值，1～2s，进入视口触发一次
- tabular-nums 防宽度抖动，千分位格式化
- reduced-motion 或 JS 失效时直接显示终值
- 不引入新依赖
完成后运行现有检查，说明修改文件。
agent.en:
Add a count-up animation to the project's stat numbers.

Check existing number display components first; avoid conflicts with live refresh logic.
Requirements:
- rAF + ease-out interpolation, 1–2s, triggered once in view
- tabular-nums to prevent jitter, thousands formatting
- Show the final value directly under reduced-motion or without JS
- No new dependencies
Run existing checks when done and list modified files.
